skills.name: A Man Takes a Name
skills.exact_visible_text: Jaqen strikes the Weakest enemy for 100% ATK True Damage. He then grants a target team member +35% Dodge Chance for 3 turns. TREASURY (5): If Jaqen chose a non-Beast ally, he Takes Their Face at 70% HP.

skills.name: Send Their Regards
skills.exact_visible_text: Roose deals 74% ATK Physical Damage to a single enemy, afflicting them with 1 BLEED. For each BLEED on the target, deal a bonus 90% ATK Physical Damage and REMOVE 1 Buff. If this attack strikes the enemy Leader, Roose gains +50% Stamina.

skills.name: As Fearsome As Any
skills.exact_visible_text: For each BIRTHRIGHT he has, Aegon II gains a +3% ATK Buff for 2 turns. He then deals +195% ATK Fire Damage to a single enemy.

skills.name: Screaming in Flames
skills.exact_visible_text: Aemond deals 30% ATK Fire Damage to a single enemy and loses 1 BIRTHRIGHT. This attack deals a bonus 29% ATK Fire Damage for each BIRTHRIGHT Aemond has.

skills.name: Bloodwyrm's Shriek
skills.exact_visible_text: Caraxes deals 114% ATK Physical Damage to all enemies. He then destroys 1 Gem, prioritizing a Power-Up and has a 80% chance to destroy 3 Hazards.

skills.name: The Sea Is My Blood
skills.exact_visible_text: Theon deals 275% ATK Physical Damage to a target. If this is the first Skill used in a turn, his target is afflicted with 1 ICE and RAID with a 65% chance for 1 bonus ICE and RAID.

skills.name: R'hllor's Mercy
skills.exact_visible_text: Thoros targets an ally. If they are alive, Thoros HEALS them for 65% ATK. The HEAL can Critically HEAL. If the target was defeated, Thoros sacrifices 35% of his Current HP and REVIVES them with 40% of their Max HP.

skills.name: Wrestle For Me
skills.exact_visible_text: Tyland grants a target team member TAUNT, 80% Power for 3 turns and 4 BIRTHRIGHT. If the target is a Greens ally, Tyland also grants 1 BLOCK. TREASURY(4): Tyland STUNS the Strongest and Weakest enemies for 3 turns.

skills.name: Giant Roar
skills.exact_visible_text: Wun Wun gains +17% DEF for 4 turns, then strikes an enemy for 390% ATK Physical Damage.

skills.name: We Do Not Sow
skills.exact_visible_text: Yara strikes an enemy for 105% ATK Physical Damage and deals a bonus 60% ATK Physical Damage for each RAID on the target.
